chapter: Gangsters, records, women musicians and the blues
title: First use of a microphone and how it would have changed her style
summary: She first used a dome microphone in Japan, found mikes cramping, and thinks she would not have used one earlier and that many singers today would not have made it.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Do you remember the first time you used a microphone?
Let me see.
When you first started there were no microphones.

No, I didn't use a mike overseas. I didn't use microphones. Let me see, the first place I used a microphone -- let me see, where was it? The Japanese were up high, looking down on us, and we were down below, and I was trying to sing so they could hear me too, you know, and they put one of those round kind of mikes, kind of like a dome. The ones they started using just before these that they're
Oh, yes.

Well, them. And I think that's the first time I started using a mike. Because first of all, you see, I moved around too much for a mike. I used to cover -- I didn't just stand in front. What are those soldiers going to do on the side?
But do you think that when you started, if they had had mikes and p.a. systems in those days, would that have --
Taken something from me.
-- would your style have been different then?
Oh, I think so.
You must have had to project so much.
I don't think I would have used it.
You have a very powerful voice.
Oh, thanks.
Even in 1961 when (Unintelligible). we made those albums,
Yeah.
You had such a powerful voice. I was just wondering, because a lot of singers nowadays, you hear them, they sound big on records.
Yeah, but that's that --
If you're in the studio with them, you see their mouth moving, but you can't even hear them. (Unintelligible) -- it's all microphones.
No. No.
I was just wondering, that it must have affected your style.
It would have, but I wouldn't use a mike. And then the couple or few times I did use it, I was just cramped up so that I had to get away from it. I just put the mike aside.
I'm sure a lot of singers, our singers today --
Yeah.
-- would never have made it back in those days.
